description: Fleiss kappa and Krippendorff alpha recomputed on v2 hand-verified clean stratum (N=240: 120 tau=1 + 120 tau=0). Bootstrap n=1000, seed=42. Source: results/judgebench_v2_panel_gate.json.
note: Agreement does NOT go negative on clean stratum. The automated-calibration-pass result (kappa goes negative) was a contamination artifact. Directional decoupling holds in sign (kappa down, Phi_V up) but the agreement drop is not statistically significant on the hand-verified stratum.
note_correction_2026_09_29: Kappa is computed from the verdicts alone, so relabelling the same items cannot change it: the automated calibration pass's negative 3-rater Fleiss kappa (-0.088 [-0.143, -0.025]; paired change from Llama+Qwen -0.163 [-0.305, -0.045]; vagt_nemotron_results.txt) was on different items (333 complete cases from the 150 automated diagnosis items and 200 clean controls) with different verdicts (nemotron_calibration_full.json: Nemotron's under the calibration prompt, Llama's and Qwen's stored from Project v1's calibration run, README A8 threat 9), and relabelling those 333 items with results/tau_hand_labels_150.json leaves it at -0.088, so 'contamination artifact' above is not shown. Each paired_deltas_vs_incumbent entry repeats the keys ci_95 and significant (Fleiss kappa first, then Krippendorff alpha); Python's json and JavaScript's JSON.parse keep only the last, the Krippendorff values. The Fleiss kappa interval for 3rater_minus_incumbent is [-0.1310, 0.0565]; docs/NEMOTRON_INSIGHTS.md and CLAUDE_CODE_CONTEXT.md quoted the Krippendorff interval [-0.1314, 0.0557] as the delta-kappa CI (corrected 2026-09-29). No values changed.
